gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-miriam-libre: Loud tube letters: Tilt Neon flares its c terminals and stands on a large x-height. Miriam Libre settles in beneath, a sans-serif with wire-fine strokes and generous s curves that give the tube letters room.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-mochiy-pop-one: Punchy tube lettering, splayed c and all, stands tall up top. Mochiy Pop One, a sans with very large lowercase eyes and a single stroke width, matches the heading's constant line best of all.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-mochiy-pop-p-one: Mochiy Pop P One reads wide and clean, with open spacing and a sizable lowercase. Tilt Neon takes the loud job with tube-like strokes, while the body font handles the quiet one through spacing.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-montserrat-underline: Bold from the first glance, Tilt Neon draws tube-like strokes with a splayed c and a large x-height. Montserrat Underline does the quiet carrying, in a sans-serif of round, uniform bowls.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-mozilla-headline: Tilt Neon shows off as a skeleton outline with a single fixed stroke thickness and a splayed c terminal. And Mozilla Headline, with big-bodied lowercase, takes over the reading duties below.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-mozilla-text: Mozilla Text packs tall, bold-looking lowercase into every line. Tilt Neon earns its keep when it is big and brief, its splayed c and constant tube stroke doing all the talking.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-nata-sans: Nata Sans reads steady and contemporary, with wide-mouthed curves and a large central band in the text line. Tilt Neon does the shouting with tube-like strokes, and the sans keeps to its technical-pen steadiness.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-nokora: Nokora is a sans that lays a thick, dark stripe of lowercase through every line, with an s that never tightens. Tilt Neon holds its own with untapered tube strokes beside it.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-noto-kufi-arabic: Noto Kufi Arabic is a modern sans with an open, welcoming gap in the c and capitals barely above lowercase. Tilt Neon adds a drafting-pen outline of constant nib width above it.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-noto-sans: Tilt Neon keeps its tube-like lines to a single thickness. Noto Sans, a sans-serif with lowercase filling most of the letter height and a wide-open c, makes paragraphs go down smoothly.
